Q5200.reason: Under Scales, membership in a mixed legal/illegal group is protected unless the member specifically intended to further its illegal aims; dues or public support alone do not defeat the First Amendment defense.

Q5207.reason: Federal courts are barred from advisory opinions; ripeness, non-mootness, and a concrete stake (standing) are the real justiciability limits.

Q5213.reason: Insulin is secreted by beta cells in the pancreatic islets of Langerhans; parietal cells secrete acid and intrinsic factor.
